name: Gaborone
subtitle: Gaborone, capital of Botswana: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 246,325 people live in Gaborone City (counted 2022).
The city is named after Kgosi Gaborone, a Batlokwa leader; the name is glossed as 'it does not fit badly'.

parts.text: The city is named after Kgosi Gaborone, a Batlokwa leader; the name is glossed as 'it does not fit badly'.

blocks.prompt: About how many people do you think live in Gaborone City?

parts.text: 246,325 in 2022, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Gaborone City (city proper, as tabulated in the 2022 Population and Housing Census, census date 18 March 2022).

items.text: The National Museum was established in Gaborone.
Formal inauguration of the University of Botswana (its roots go back to the University of Basutoland, Bechuanaland and Swaziland, opened 1964).
The Three Dikgosi Monument was inaugurated by President Festus Mogae.
